mechanism: Reputation via micro-deviation detection. 1. Baseline: establish behavioral frequency over `window_size` samples. 2. Sample: continuous high-resolution observation. 3. Detect: alert when {{distance}}(Current, Baseline) exceeds `threshold`. 4. Witness: aggregated peer reports. Tracks behavioral consistency against a baseline {{aggregate}} of historical actions.
gloss: Reputation scoring via behavioral deviation from baseline (2-sigma alert)
failure_modes: Baseline walked: the subject changes more slowly than the baseline recomputes, so no alert fires.
Witness collusion: coordinated false drift reports.
False reports: a single malicious witness.
Cold start: no baseline yet, so the watcher is silent through the establishment window.
Baseline gaming: {{agent}} varies early to establish a wide baseline.
Alert flood: continuous sampling against a sensitive threshold alerts at its false-positive rate.
invariants: Baseline is immutable while a sample is judged against it.
Baseline recomputation interval and source window are declared.
Alert when {{distance}}(Current, Baseline) > `threshold`, in the units {{distance}} returns.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Trigger in the units {{distance}} returns — not normalised, not sigma multiples.

parameters.name: recompute_interval
parameters.description: Samples between baseline rebuilds; 0 pins it permanently.
